evidence.reason: The finding's concern is that makeRunReport composes the readiness section into the tracker PR body and calls editPrBody without any denylist scan, unlike the assembler. At this tip the tracker write path now composes the body, checks that a publicationScanner is configured, and runs scanPublicationForUpload on the composed body before editPrBody (lines 310-313), with the missing-scanner case throwing and being converted to a `failed` result. The supplied history confirms this was introduced by commit 7096a7fa ("fix(pr): scan the run report's tracker body before publication"), so the recommended change is already present in the current code.
